title.en: Choose What Is Lawful and Good

description.id: Pilih makanan yang halal, baik, aman, dan diperoleh secara benar.
description.en: Choose food that is lawful, wholesome, safe, and rightfully obtained.

description.id: Makan dengan kesadaran kepada Allah dan mensyukuri rezeki yang diberikan.
description.en: Eat with awareness of God and gratitude for the provision received.

description.id: Makan dan minum secukupnya serta hindari pemborosan.
description.en: Eat and drink in moderation and avoid waste.

description.id: Bagikan makanan kepada kerabat dan orang yang membutuhkan tanpa mengharap pujian.
description.en: Share food with relatives and people in need without seeking praise.

description.id: Jaga kebersihan, kenyamanan bersama, dan hindari mencela makanan atau pilihan wajar orang lain.
description.en: Maintain cleanliness and shared comfort, and avoid disparaging food or others' reasonable choices.
